    ScalarProportionality is proved (MildContours/Assembly/ExcAssembly.lean), so BGRS multiplicative bases hold (twistedMulBasisExists_of_scalar). Bongartz's Theorem 6, Theorem A and both corollaries now depend only on CoverDichotomy (the dichotomy on the universal cover).
